summary.intent: Coordinate subagent fixes for two PRs (#347 fix/detect-and-explain-skips and #343 fix/component-type-lists), merging origin/main, resolving review findings, and getting CI and Entire Gates to pass.
summary.outcome: Both PRs were merged with main and fixed with pushes, but CI and Entire Gates were still pending. Verification on GitHub showed #347 had two new medium findings despite the worker reporting 0 open, so the worker was sent back to fix the structure; #343 is waiting on queued CI.

repo: Entire Gates review runs after pushes and can add findings after the count briefly reads 0; counts are only reliable once Entire Gates finishes (`entire trail finding list caliper/<id>`).
Interface collection must be keyed by declaration scope, not bare name: function-local `interface Props` merged into a module-level one leaked a required prop into the exported component.
React/Preact module checks are consolidated in `react_types::is_react_module` and `is_preact_module`; the resolver also accepts `preact/compat`.
Element-factory names are consolidated in a single `ELEMENT_FACTORIES` list with `is_element_factory_name`/`is_element_factory_callee`, used by evidence.rs, uses.rs and wrapper.rs.
`h` counts as render evidence only when imported from Preact (bare or on Preact's namespace), not member calls like `codec.h(...)` or local functions named `h`.

Pre-commit verification uses `just lint doc-check machete typos`, and clean-room testing uses a detached git worktree with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline` and `cargo nextest run --workspace --no-fail-fast`.

Repo rules referenced by the worker: fix siblings via rg (rule 2), declared vs required deps (rule 3), banned patterns like `as unknown as`, `.ok()?`, `let _ =`, `|| true` and empty catch (rule 4), and a failing-before-fix exact-content test (rule 5).

code.finding: `imports_a_value` was added so type-only specifiers from react don't make a TS file count as having components; call sites around lines 644–682 use the shared react-module predicate.
Re-exports `is_type_only`; checked as a sibling and not affected by the import-kind fix.
Demand filter on exact "react" specifier; judged out of scope and unaffected by the preact/compat change.

workflow: Subagent self-reports of 'open findings 0' can be stale or premature; independently verify CI and review state on GitHub before accepting a hand-back.

When a review keeps finding variants of the same bug, fix the structure (define the scope model, key by it, enumerate scope × order × count cases against TypeScript's checker, and audit other name-keyed collections) rather than patching each case.
A clean-room worktree run is a good check against ambient-state test failures in a developer worktree.

friction: Interface-merge fix for #347 took three review rounds (order bug, then regression) and still left new medium findings.
Snapshot tests failed once in the worker's own worktree on #347 due to ambient state, though the clean room passed.
CI was slow or queued: all 16 non-Entire checks on #343 were still QUEUED and Entire Gates was IN_PROGRESS, so final results could not be confirmed.
One test was flagged 'leaky' in the #347 clean-room run and was not investigated.
open_items: Wait for CI and Entire Gates on #343 and re-check its findings once done.
The #347 worker must resolve the two new medium findings with a scope-keyed interface registry and exhaustive scope × order × count tests.
Audit other collections keyed by bare name for the same scope flaw.
Add a resolver-level behavioral test for a `preact/compat` type import (only the predicate is unit-tested).
Investigate the 'leaky' test flagged in the #347 clean-room run.
Another worker on #367/#348/#349 is still running.
No changesets were added to either PR.
